SELECT bucket AS time, return_temp FROM heat_pump_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY 1

SELECT bucket AS time, dhw_temp FROM heat_pump_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: COP (selected range)

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(heat_kwh) / NULLIF(sum(elec_kwh), 0) AS cop FROM energy_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND heat_kwh IS NOT NULL AND elec_kwh IS NOT NULL

panels.description: Sum of heat delivered / sum of electricity consumed over the selected range (energy_1m, minutes with both deltas only).

panels.title: Operating Mode
panels.description: Operating Mode of the latest minute (derived in heat_pump_1m from the Heat Pump's status flags).

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, operating_mode FROM heat_pump_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND operating_mode IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Compressor Frequency
panels.description: Compressor Frequency (compressor speed) of the Heat Pump, latest minute average. 0 = compressor off.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, compressor_hz AS "Compressor Frequency" FROM heat_pump_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND compressor_hz IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
SELECT bucket AS time, operating_mode FROM heat_pump_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY 1

SELECT bucket AS time, flow_temp AS "Flow Temperature", return_temp AS "Return Temperature", outdoor_temp AS "Outdoor Temperature", room_temp AS "Room Temperature", dhw_temp AS "DHW Temperature", target_flow_temp AS "Target Flow Temperature" FROM heat_pump_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY 1
SELECT bucket AS time, device AS metric, power_w FROM power_1m WHERE device IN ('electricity_meter','heat_meter') AND $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Delta T – Space Heating (avg, target 5 K)
panels.description: Average Delta T across the Heat Pump (Flow Temperature − Return Temperature) over Space Heating minutes in the selected range. ~5 K is ideal: green 4–6 K, orange 3–4 / 6–7 K, red outside.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(delta_t) AS "Space Heating" FROM heat_pump_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND operating_mode = 'Space Heating'

panels.title: Delta T – DHW (avg)
panels.description: Average Delta T across the Heat Pump over DHW minutes in the selected range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(delta_t) AS "DHW" FROM heat_pump_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND operating_mode = 'DHW'

panels.title: Delta T across the Heat Pump by Operating Mode (5 K = Space Heating target)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT bucket AS time,
  CASE WHEN operating_mode = 'Space Heating' THEN delta_t END AS "Space Heating",
  CASE WHEN operating_mode = 'DHW' THEN delta_t END AS "DHW"
FROM heat_pump_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: COP per hour by Operating Mode

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, operating_mode AS metric, cop FROM cop_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: COP per day by Operating Mode

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(bucket AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam','YYYY-MM-DD') AS day, operating_mode, cop FROM cop_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY bucket

SELECT bucket AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam' AS day, operating_mode AS "Operating Mode", heat_kwh AS "Heat kWh", elec_kwh AS "Electricity kWh", cop AS "COP", minutes AS "Minutes" FROM cop_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY bucket DESC, operating_mode

panels.title: Heat calibration factor per day (Heat Meter counter / flow x Delta T)

targets.rawSql: SELECT day::timestamp AS time, factor AS "Factor", CASE WHEN valid THEN factor END AS "Factor (valid, applied)" FROM heat_calibration_daily WHERE day >= ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date AND day <= ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Per Europe/Amsterdam day: Heat Meter energy counter divided by the energy from flow rate x Delta T. Valid points are applied to heat_kwh (complete day, >= 5 kWh, factor 0.8 to 1.25); invalid days fall back to the latest valid factor of the previous 7 days, else 1.0. Drift away from 1.0 means a sensor or meter issue. See ADR-0003.

panels.title: COP vs Break-even COP (selected range)

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(heat_kwh) / NULLIF(sum(elec_kwh), 0) AS "COP", (sum(elec_cost_eur) / NULLIF(sum(elec_kwh), 0)) / NULLIF(sum(gas_cost_eur) / NULLIF(sum(heat_kwh), 0), 0) AS "Break-even COP" FROM energy_cost_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket)

panels.description: COP = heat / electricity. Break-even COP = average all-in electricity price actually paid (weighted by consumption, per quarter hour) / price of the same heat from gas (all-in gas price / (9.769 kWh/m3 x 0.90 boiler efficiency)). COP above Break-even COP: the Heat Pump is cheaper than gas. Only minutes with prices and both meters (energy_cost_1m).

panels.title: Heat Pump electricity cost (selected range)

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(elec_cost_eur) AS "Electricity" FROM energy_cost_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket)

panels.description: Sum of electricity kWh x easyEnergy all-in price of that quarter hour (market + VAT + energy tax + purchase fee). Fixed monthly charges excluded.

panels.title: Same heat from gas (selected range)

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(gas_cost_eur) AS "Gas" FROM energy_cost_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket)

panels.description: What the delivered heat would have cost from a gas boiler (90 % efficiency on gross calorific value) at the easyEnergy all-in gas price of that day. Fixed monthly charges excluded.

panels.title: Savings vs gas (selected range)

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(gas_cost_eur) - sum(elec_cost_eur) AS "Savings" FROM energy_cost_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket)

panels.description: Same heat from gas minus Heat Pump electricity cost. Negative: gas would have been cheaper.

panels.title: COP vs Break-even COP per hour

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', bucket) AS time, sum(heat_kwh) / NULLIF(sum(elec_kwh), 0) AS "COP", (sum(elec_cost_eur) / NULLIF(sum(elec_kwh), 0)) / NULLIF(sum(gas_cost_eur) / NULLIF(sum(heat_kwh), 0), 0) AS "Break-even COP (weighted)" FROM energy_cost_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT starts AS time, breakeven_cop AS "Break-even COP (price, per quarter)" FROM breakeven_cop WHERE $__timeFilter(starts) ORDER BY 1

panels.description: COP per hour vs the Break-even COP weighted by that hour's consumption. The dashed line is the price-only Break-even COP per quarter hour (also when the Heat Pump is idle, and tomorrow's once published ~13:00): running when it is low is cheapest.

panels.title: COP vs Break-even COP per day

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(bucket AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam','YYYY-MM-DD') AS day, cop AS "COP", breakeven_cop AS "Break-even COP", savings_eur AS "Savings vs gas" FROM energy_cost_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND operating_mode = 'Combined' ORDER BY bucket

panels.description: Per local day (energy_cost_daily, Combined): COP vs consumption-weighted Break-even COP. Savings vs gas in the tooltip.

panels.title: easyEnergy all-in prices: electricity vs heat from gas

targets.rawSql: SELECT starts AS time, elec_price_eur_kwh AS "Electricity (EUR/kWh)", gas_heat_price_eur_kwh AS "Heat from gas (EUR/kWh heat)", gas_price_eur_m3 AS "Gas (EUR/m3)" FROM breakeven_cop WHERE $__timeFilter(starts) ORDER BY 1

panels.description: All-in per-unit prices incl. VAT, energy tax and easyEnergy purchase fee (energy_prices.invoice_price). Heat from gas = gas price / (9.769 kWh/m3 x 0.90). Break-even COP = electricity / heat from gas.

panels.title: Short Cycling (cycles < 10 min)

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS short_cycles FROM compressor_cycles($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) WHERE duration < interval '10 minutes'

panels.description: Completed Compressor Cycles shorter than 10 minutes in the selected range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS cycles FROM compressor_cycles($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo())

SELECT to_char(date_trunc('hour', cycle_start AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam'),'MM-DD HH24"h"') AS hour, count(*)::int AS cycles FROM compressor_cycles($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', cycle_start AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam') ORDER BY date_trunc('hour', cycle_start AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam')

SELECT to_char(time_bucket('1 day', cycle_start, 'Europe/Amsterdam') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam','YYYY-MM-DD') AS day, count(*)::int AS cycles FROM compressor_cycles($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT cycle_start AS "Start", cycle_end AS "End", extract(epoch FROM duration) / 60 AS "Duration (min)" FROM compressor_cycles($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) ORDER BY cycle_start DESC

SELECT label AS "Duration", count(*)::int AS cycles FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN m < 5 THEN '00-05' WHEN m < 10 THEN '05-10' WHEN m < 20 THEN '10-20' WHEN m < 30 THEN '20-30' WHEN m < 60 THEN '30-60' ELSE '60+' END AS label, CASE WHEN m < 5 THEN 1 WHEN m < 10 THEN 2 WHEN m < 20 THEN 3 WHEN m < 30 THEN 4 WHEN m < 60 THEN 5 ELSE 6 END AS ord FROM (SELECT extract(epoch FROM duration) / 60 AS m FROM compressor_cycles($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) WHERE duration IS NOT NULL) q) r GROUP BY label, ord ORDER BY ord

panels.title: Compressor Frequency

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, compressor_hz AS "Compressor Frequency" FROM heat_pump_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Compressor Frequency (minute average). Low frequency with short Compressor Cycles points to over-sized capacity or a too-low Heating Curve.

panels.title: Data freshness

targets.rawSql: SELECT device AS "Device", last_time AS "Last reading", age_seconds AS "Age (s)", t AS "Threshold (s)", age_seconds / t AS "Age / threshold" FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN device IN ('heat_pump','electricity_meter') THEN 15 WHEN device = 'heat_meter' THEN 90 ELSE 30 END AS t FROM data_freshness) f ORDER BY device

panels.description: Age of the last reading per device. Red when above the device's expected cadence budget: Heat Pump / Electricity Meter 15 s, Heat Meter 90 s, Heat Boosters 30 s.
